description: Defines a class ProjectSyncStatusNotificationProvider that provides notifications about Gradle project sync status within an IDE, including progress, failure, and need for sync.

classes.name: ProjectSyncStatusNotificationProvider
classes.description: Provides IDE notifications related to Gradle project sync status, including in-progress, failed, or outdated sync states.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key used to identify this notification provider.

methods.name: createNotificationPanel
methods.description: Creates and returns a notification panel based on the current sync state.

inner_classes.name: StaleGradleModelNotificationPanel
inner_classes.description: Notification panel indicating that Gradle files have changed and a sync may be needed.

methods.name: StaleGradleModelNotificationPanel
methods.description: Constructor that sets the notification text and action to trigger a project sync.

inner_classes.name: ProjectImportFailedNotificationPanel
inner_classes.description: Notification panel indicating that Gradle sync failed, with options to retry, view messages, or show logs.

methods.name: ProjectImportFailedNotificationPanel
methods.description: Constructor that sets the failure message and actions for retrying sync, opening message view, or viewing logs.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the unique key for this notification provider.

methods.name: createNotificationPanel
methods.description: Creates a notification panel based on the project's Gradle sync status.
